implemented_capabilities: Nine intent categories and four priority levels
Pydantic-validated ticket input and JSON result schema
Escalation flag for high and urgent cases
JSON response parsing and schema validation
Exponential retry/backoff for provider failures and malformed output
Safety-oriented draft responses and ticket text treated as untrusted input
Deterministic priority floor and security-category override applied after optional provider output is parsed
limitations: Rules and benchmark examples are handcrafted; production intent performance has not been measured.
Confidence values are heuristic and are not calibrated probabilities.
Real-provider integration was not called during validation; adapter tests used a mock transport.
Review privacy, security, escalation policy and human-in-the-loop workflows before production use.
